cd /mnt/session/outputs/coverage && python3 -c "
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import json
d=json.load(open('coverage.json'))
fs=[f['file'] for f in d['frames']]
for k in range(0,len(fs),4):
  sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1920,1080),'black')
  for j,f in enumerate(fs[k:k+4]):
    im=Image.open(f).convert('RGB').resize((960,540))
    ImageDraw.Draw(im).text((10,10),f,fill='red')
    sheet.paste(im,((j%2)*960,(j//2)*540))
  sheet.save('/tmp/sheet%d.png'%(k//4))
print(len(fs))
"
